channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: JPMorgan reduz recomendação para ações brasileiras e cita volatilidade eleitoral
item.description: JPMorgan downgraded its recommendation for Brazilian stocks from 'overweight' to 'neutral', citing slower interest rate cuts and a more prolonged disinflation process as factors expected to pressure the equity market for the rest of 2026. The move reflects concerns about electoral volatility impacting economic stability and investor confidence.

item.title: PF pede a Moraes para que decida destino de armas apreendidas de Bolsonaro
item.description: The Federal Police asked Minister Alexandre de Moraes of the STF to decide the fate of ten firearms seized from former President Jair Bolsonaro. The PF argues that Moraes should determine whether the weapons will be returned, destroyed, or assigned another purpose, given the legal implications of the case. The request comes amid investigations into possible irregularities in Bolsonaro’s firearm possession.

item.title: Lula começa a gravar vídeos para a campanha com candidatos aliados nesta semana
item.description: President Lula begins this week recording campaign videos at his re-election headquarters in Brasília, starting with gubernatorial candidates, followed by senatorial and congressional candidates. The sessions are coordinated by Edinho Silva, PT president and campaign coordinator. Electoral advertising on TV and radio officially starts on August 28, following the campaign launch on Sunday the 16th.

item.title: Ibovespa cai 2,50% e fecha aos 167,8 mil pontos com aumento da percepção de risco no Brasil
item.description: The Ibovespa fell 2.50% to close at 167,874 points, pressured by JPMorgan’s downgrade from 'overweight' to 'neutral', citing risks of a pause in the interest rate cutting cycle after September 2026 and potential impacts from the 2026 elections on Brazilian assets. The move also affected futures interest rates and the exchange rate, with foreign capital outflows of $2.46 billion and $2.26 billion on August 6 and 7, respectively, alongside the release of the CNT/MDA election poll and July’s IPCA, which came in above expectations.

item.title: Lula deve receber Alcolumbre nesta terça no Alvorada
item.description: President Lula is set to meet with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre on Tuesday (August 11) at the Palácio da Alvorada to advance key government priorities in Congress, including the MP ending the 'blusinhas tax', the Public Security PEC, and the PEC proposing the end of the 6×1 work schedule. The meeting follows a previous encounter at Justice Alexandre de Moraes’ residence and aims to accelerate votes before the electoral recess, as the MP expires on September 8 if not approved. The electoral calendar narrows the window for legislative action, increasing pressure on the government.

item.title: Vídeo de IA de Bolsonaro não é deepfake, diz Flávio ao TSE
item.description: The defense of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) asked the TSE to dismiss a complaint from the Brazil of Hope federation over an AI-generated video simulating a speech by former President Jair Bolsonaro, claiming it is not a deepfake. The video was shown at the PL convention and sparked controversy for potentially manipulating the ex-president’s image. The defense argues the content is a legitimate AI production without intent to deceive voters.

item.title: Zema pede reação de jornalistas contra decisão de Moraes: “Não se calem”
item.description: Former governor Romeu Zema (Novo) urged journalists to react against a decision by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, who authorized a search and seizure operation against former Maranhão state secretary Raimundo Cutrim, identified as a source for journalist Luís Pablo in reports about Minister Flávio Dino. Zema defended press freedom and encouraged journalists not to remain silent in the face of the measure.

item.title: Empresas do Reino Unido enviam pedidos para presidenciáveis do Brasil
item.description: UK-based companies, represented by Britcham, sent a letter to Brazilian presidential candidates requesting a free trade agreement with Mercosul, the removal of tariffs and regulatory barriers to foreign investment, and the abolition of taxes on profits and dividends repatriated abroad and on Brazilian oil exports. The organization argues that Brazil has unique conditions to become a top global investment destination, provided it improves its business environment.

item.title: Dois últimos eleitores acompanham impressão do boletim de urna
item.description: The 2026 general elections in Brazil will introduce a novelty: the two last voters in each polling station will be invited to witness the printing of the ballot bulletin, a document summarizing the voting results at that station, as per TSE regulations. The measure aims to enhance transparency and public trust in the electoral system by allowing citizens to observe the tabulation process without compromising vote secrecy. The ballot bulletin does not reveal individual votes but only aggregated data, such as total voters, votes by office, and validation codes.

item.title: Petistas e aliados de Lula exploram slogan de Flávio e associam a 'V de Vorcaro'
item.description: PT lawmakers and Lula’s allies are repurposing Flávio Bolsonaro’s campaign slogan, 'O Brasil vai vencer', to criticize him, linking the 'V' to 'Vorcaro' in a political counterattack. The exclusive subscriber-only article highlights this tactic as part of the left’s effort to undermine the image of the bolsonarist senator.

item.title: Lula terá "intensivão" de gravações com 50 candidatos; veja bastidores
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's (PT) campaign is preparing an 'intensivo' recording session on August 14, 2026, at the PT headquarters in Brasília, featuring at least 50 candidates for Senate and state governorships. The speeches will be short and objective, with Lula wearing a hat on medical advice due to treatment for basal cell carcinoma on his scalp. The campaign has already recorded at least 10 TV programs and is intensifying the 'fala, povo' format to leverage extended television time in the election.

item.title: 'Taxa das blusinhas': Congresso vai instalar comissão para analisar MP na quarta-feira
item.description: The National Congress has scheduled the installation of a mixed committee for Wednesday (12) to analyze the provisional measure that eliminates the 'blusinhas tax', a 20% import duty on international purchases under US$50. The MP, issued by Lula in May, will expire on September 24 if not approved, after which the tax will be reinstated. Chamber President Hugo Motta said he will continue talks with the Senate and government to define the review process, stressing the urgency due to the deadline.

item.title: Fim das taxas das blusinhas precisa ser votado 'nas próximas semanas' para não perder validade, diz presidente da Câmara
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta says the provisional measure ending the 'blusinhas tax' (20% on international purchases) must be voted in the coming weeks to avoid expiration, with a final deadline of September 8. The Lula government aims to use Congress's concentrated effort period (August 10–14 and August 31–September 3) to pass the measure, as allies fear its lapse could be exploited to harm Lula electorally ahead of the 2026 elections. The issue is also tied to the fuel PLP, another priority in the leaders' agenda.

item.title: Van Hattem vai ao PL com Flávio, mas reforça apoio a Zema
item.description: Deputy Marcel Van Hattem (Novo-RS) visited the national headquarters of the PL in Brasília alongside Flávio Bolsonaro, but reiterated his support for Romeu Zema's (Novo) presidential candidacy. Despite the meeting with the Liberal Party, Van Hattem affirmed he remains aligned with Zema’s political project, his original party. He is running for Senate from Rio Grande do Sul.

item.title: Lula desembarca em MG para lançar candidatura de Patrus
item.description: President Lula traveled to Minas Gerais to launch the campaign of Patrus Ananias for governor, marking their first joint public appearance since the PT confirmed his candidacy. The event took place in Belo Horizonte on August 21, following prior meetings between Lula and Patrus to secure key agenda support. Despite Patrus’s strong record as former mayor of Belo Horizonte — creator of the Participatory Budget and Popular Restaurants — the PT struggles to build a broad coalition, with allies like the PSB joining only under national pressure.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula manobrou Centrão para isolar Flávio
item.description: The Centrão is distancing itself from the Lula government due to low presidential approval and rising right-wing support in polls, aiming to align with the next president. The Centrão's power alternation strategy was disrupted by Lula's maneuvers, allegedly aimed at isolating Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The government's strategy seeks to weaken direct opposition to the Planalto.

item.title: Michelle se reúne com Flávio Bolsonaro pela 1ª vez após desavenças: 'Qual família é perfeita?'
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio Bolsonaro met for the first time following family disagreements, reconciling with an embrace. During the meeting, they recorded inserts for Flávio’s electoral campaign, signaling renewed political alignment. Michelle stated she had placed a 'stone' on their differences, adding that 'no family is perfect'.

item.title: Candidata do PSOL de TO erra e declara R$ 2 bi em bens ao TSE
item.description: Lucia Viana, the PSOL candidate for vice-governor of Tocantins, declared R$ 2 billion in assets to the TSE, but claimed it was a material error in filling out the declaration. The amount is incompatible with her known patrimonial profile and raised concerns about the accuracy of electoral asset disclosures.

item.title: Lula liga para Motta e agradece por declaração de apoio à reeleição
item.description: President Lula called House Speaker Hugo Motta to thank him for publicly supporting his reelection bid. Motta also discussed with Lula’s ministers a proposal to cut or eliminate federal taxes on gasoline, diesel, and ethanol during periods of high oil prices. Motta’s support is driven by electoral calculations, including securing Planalto backing for his father’s Senate bid in 2026 and his own re-election as House Speaker in 2027.

item.title: Lula gravará vídeos com candidatos aliados nesta semana
item.description: President Lula will record videos and hold photo sessions this week with gubernatorial and senatorial candidates from the PT and allied parties. The recordings will take place at the headquarters of his re-election campaign in Lago Sul, Brasília, starting on Thursday (August 13). The invitations are being coordinated by PT national president Edinho Silva, who is also running for federal deputy from São Paulo.

item.title: "Um dia de cada vez", afirma Michelle sobre relação com enteados
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro stated she is gradually adjusting her relationship with her stepchildren Carlos and Eduardo Bolsonaro, following her public dispute with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. She said she holds no grudges, has a 'clean heart,' and believes things are improving slowly, one day at a time.

item.title: Brasil é convidado para cúpula de bloco asiático em reunião de Lula no Planalto
item.description: President Lula received Philippine Chancellor Maria Theresa Lazaro at the Planalto Palace to celebrate 80 years of bilateral relations between Brazil and the Philippines. During the meeting, Lazaro formally invited Brazil to participate in the upcoming ASEAN Summit in November, one of the most important gatherings of Southeast Asian leaders. They also discussed economic and technological cooperation, particularly in defense and semiconductors, and emphasized the need to diversify Brazil’s exports, noting that the Philippines is currently the world’s largest importer of Brazilian pork.

item.title: Caiado gasta R$ 621 mil nas redes, mas segue com o pior engajamento entre presidenciáveis
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado spent R$ 621,000 on political advertising on Facebook and Instagram over the last 90 days, peaking at R$ 22,800 per day between July 31 and August 6. Despite the high expenditure, his organic engagement is the worst among presidential candidates: just 0.4% on Instagram, with 2.25 million followers. The issue is not lack of exposure, but low efficiency in converting spending into interaction.

item.title: O medo de Lula e Flávio nos pontapés iniciais das suas campanhas
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro fear that the initial events of their 2026 campaigns will fail to draw large crowds, which opponents could use as evidence of weak popular support. Lula aims to fill the Estádio Municipal 1º de Maio in São Bernardo do Campo with at least 25,000 people, avoiding a repeat of the low turnout at the May 1, 2024 event. Flávio seeks to pack Copacabana’s beachfront in Rio de Janeiro, emulating the success of Jair Bolsonaro’s September 7, 2022 rally, to prevent mockery from Lula’s supporters.

item.title: Michelle grava vídeos para campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro após briga: “Colocamos uma pedra”
item.description: Former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro recorded campaign videos for her stepson, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), and publicly announced that their conflict has been resolved, stating they 'put a stone' on the disagreement. The reconciliation followed disputes over PL alliances in Ceará and the replacement of a candidate she supported. Now appearing together in electoral material, they aim to unite Bolsonaro supporters behind the presidential bid.

item.title: Michelle grava vídeo de campanha com Flávio Bolsonaro e diz que colocaram ‘pedra em atrito’
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro said she has overcome tensions with her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro, stating she 'put a stone' in their disagreements after meeting and recording campaign materials together. She said she holds no resentment, though she did not confirm whether she will travel across Brazil to support his candidacy, limiting herself to social media support. Michelle also reaffirmed her opposition to the PL's alliance with Ciro Gomes in Ceará, citing coherence with Jair Bolsonaro's ineligibility, and endorsed Celina Leão for governor of the Federal District.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro diz ter colocado pedra em crise com Flávio e expõe preferência por vice mulher
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro said she had 'placed a stone' in the rift with her stepson, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, after recording a political propaganda piece with him. She made the statement on Tuesday, August 11, 2026, and also expressed her preference for a woman as the vice-presidential candidate on the Bolsonaro-aligned ticket for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Michelle sobre vice de Flávio: "Gostaria que fosse uma mulher"
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro expressed a preference for a woman as vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro's ticket, stating that as a representative of Brazil's decent women, she would have liked to see a woman in that role. She praised the atmosphere with Flávio during electoral propaganda recordings, saying family arguments are normal and joking: 'Who hasn't fought with their family should raise their hand'.

item.title: Depois da crise, Michelle e Flávio Bolsonaro ensaiam nova sintonia na campanha
item.description: Michelle and Flávio Bolsonaro appeared together for the first time since their family conflict in June, during the recording of the presidential candidate's electoral program, signaling reconciliation after public disagreements. Michelle said they had 'put a stone' on the fight and that the matter is 'a page turned', while Flávio called her participation a 'great honor'. The meeting took place before the official start of the electoral campaign on August 16, with radio and TV ads beginning August 28.

item.title: Moraes já decidiu a favor de Dino e seu grupo político no Maranhão pelo menos quatro vezes
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has made at least four decisions favoring Flávio Dino and his political group in Maranhão, including search and seizure warrants against critics' allies. The most recent targeted Raimundo Cutrim, a former secretary removed by Dino and under house arrest, linked to investigations into alleged obstruction of justice. These actions occurred within the indefinite fake news inquiry, backed by the PGR, and also included blocking appointments of relatives of Governor Carlos Brandão.

item.title: Presidente da CPI do INSS aumenta patrimônio de R$ 3,5 milhões para R$ 13,6 milhões em apenas 2 anos
item.description: Senator Carlos Viana (PSD-MG), president of the INSS CPI and 2026 reelection candidate, declared R$13.64 million in assets to the TSE, up from R$3.5 million in 2024 — a 282.6% increase. He attributes the rise mainly to R$6.31 million in agricultural debts and consortia, emphasizing that his net worth has decreased since 2018. In 2024, his top asset was a R$1.96 million apartment; now he holds R$4.1 million in real estate and R$2.5 million in company stakes.

item.title: Após crise, Michelle e Flávio têm reencontro ‘leve’, oram e gravam juntos: os bastidores do evento
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio Bolsonaro met in person for the first time since the campaign’s internal crisis, in a described ‘light’ and friendly atmosphere at the campaign headquarters in Brasília. They prayed together, recorded electoral materials, and Michelle spoke on behalf of herself and Jair Bolsonaro to Senate candidates, reaffirming mutual support. Michelle indicated her physical presence in the campaign will be limited, focusing on social media and women’s structures, due to her caregiving responsibilities for the former president.

item.title: Por que as filhas são seguros para a velhice?
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president, stated he had two daughters specifically so they would take care of him in old age, sparking controversy over the instrumentalization of women. The remark was made while explaining the role of women in society on last Wednesday (5).

item.title: Ataques de Milei a Lula são rejeitados por 70,5% dos argentinos, diz pesquisa
item.description: A survey by Zuban Córdoba found that 70.5% of Argentines disapprove of President Javier Milei's attacks on Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Only 20% approve of Milei's criticisms, while 9.5% were unsure or did not respond. The poll was released on November 8, 2026.

item.title: Flávio elogia Michelle e diz que ela terá acesso direto à Presidência
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that Michelle Bolsonaro would have direct access to the Presidency if he is elected and she becomes a senator from the DF. He praised her qualifications and work as former first lady, particularly with the deaf community, and emphasized their alliance with Bia Kicis to strengthen the PL in the Federal District. The remarks were made during electoral propaganda recordings in Brasília, following a family tension that was resolved after Flávio issued a public apology.

item.title: Presidente do PT diz que se Alcolumbre quiser se aproximar de Lula ele deve aprovar 6x1
item.description: PT president Edinho Silva said Senate president Davi Alcolumbre must approve the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule as a gesture to reapproach President Lula. The statement was made during a PT caucus meeting in the Chamber after being asked about their relationship. The government considers voting on this PEC a top priority for the 2026 electoral campaign, as it has been stalled in the Senate since May.

item.title: 'Levanta a mão aí quem não tem problema na família', diz Michelle após gravar programa eleitoral com Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio Bolsonaro recorded electoral programming together, marking their first in-person meeting after family tensions. She stated they set aside their differences, noting that no family is perfect and their unity is for the greater good of the nation. The electoral campaign officially begins on the 16th, with TV and radio ads starting August 28th.

item.title: Lula terá foto com chapéu na urna pela primeira vez; regra mudou em 2022, entenda
item.description: President Lula will wear a hat on his electronic ballot photo in 2026, the first time since 1989, due to a 2022 electoral law change allowing head accessories for medical or sociocultural reasons. The measure follows medical advice after skin cancer treatment on his scalp. The rule was changed following a lawsuit by Douglas Belchior (PT-SP), who was barred from wearing a cap on his ballot image in 2022.

item.title: Flávio critica Moraes após busca e apreensão contra fonte de jornalista
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) criticized a decision by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes that authorized search and seizure against former Maranhão Security Secretary Raimundo Cutrim, identified as a source for journalist Luís Pablo in reports against Minister Flávio Dino. During a press conference, Flávio defended source confidentiality as 'sacred', calling the measure a threat to press freedom and urging journalists to unite against what he described as abuse and arbitrariness. He also offered barbecue meat and soda to journalists, joking about Lula's promise of picanha.

item.title: Câmara Britânica envia pacote de propostas econômicas aos presidenciáveis
item.description: Britcham has sent a set of economic policy proposals to the five leading presidential candidates in Brazil to strengthen bilateral trade and investment relations with the United Kingdom. The recommendations focus on economic integration, tax competitiveness, and legal security, targeting key sectors such as infrastructure, energy, and technology. The group noted that bilateral trade reached £13 billion in the past year and that UK direct investment in Brazil totals £27.6 billion.

item.title: Michelle reencontra Flávio, relembra ter sido 'desrespeitada', mas trata crise como 'superada: 'Colocamos uma pedra'
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro reunited with her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro after a rift in the 2026 presidential campaign, saying she had 'put a stone' on the disagreement and that their relationship is being rebuilt, though still in a process of adjustment. She said they prayed together, recorded campaign materials, and intends to support the campaign mainly via social media due to her caregiving duties for Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest.

item.title: “Taxa das blusinhas”: Governo pede a Davi Alcolumbre instalação de comissão
item.description: The federal government formally requests the installation of a mixed committee in Congress to analyze the MP that eliminates the 20% import tax on online purchases up to US$50, known as the 'blusinhas tax', with validity expiring on September 8. The measure faces strong opposition from business groups, particularly the CNI, which argues it harms domestic industry, while the government pushes for swift approval to avoid lapsing amid a tight electoral calendar.

item.title: Os elogios de Flávio a Michelle antes de gravação de programa eleitoral
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro recorded his electoral program on Tuesday (11) with the participation of Michelle Bolsonaro, his stepmother and former first lady, marking their first public meeting since the pre-campaign rift. He praised Michelle as a 'qualified person' and highlighted her work for the deaf community, stating that she and deputy Bia Kicis would have direct access to the Presidency in a potential government. Other PL Senate candidates and São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas also appeared in the recording.

item.title: Corte Eleitoral rejeita recurso do PT e aliados em ação contra Nikolas
item.description: The Minas Gerais Regional Electoral Court unanimously rejected a petition by the PT, PCdoB, and PV to cassate the mandate of federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira over alleged abuse of communication power. The court ruled that the contested posts and videos were made after his election, so they could not have affected the electoral outcome. Ferreira celebrated the decision on social media with the message 'Communist sad, Brazil happy'.

item.title: Candidata do PSOL a vice-governadora de Tocantins erra e declara ter R$ 2,07 bilhões em bens
item.description: The PSOL candidate for vice-governor of Tocantins, Lúcia Viana, erroneously declared R$ 2.07 billion in assets to the TSE due to a data entry error in her asset declaration. The party clarified that the correct amount is approximately R$ 2.07 million, supported by documentation, and has requested an official correction. Viana is a retired public servant and lawyer running on a ticket with first-time candidate Witer Naves, a middle school teacher.

item.title: “É impossível aplaudir quem fez negócios com banqueiro bandido”, diz Zema
item.description: Romeu Zema said he will not repeat criticisms about the link between Flávio Bolsonaro and former banker Daniel Vorcaro, but maintained his position that it is impossible to applaud someone who did business with someone deemed a 'crook'. He stated the issue had already been sufficiently debated during the presidential campaign.

item.title: Antes de se encontrarem em gravação, Flávio Bolsonaro elogia Michelle e diz que ela terá acesso direto à Presidência
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro praised Michelle Bolsonaro as a qualified person and stated she would have direct access to the Presidency if both are elected, to address demands from the Federal District. He highlighted her work with the deaf community during Jair Bolsonaro’s government and emphasized that Michelle, alongside Bia Kicis, would have a direct channel to the Planalto Palace. The Brasília meeting marked the first in-person encounter between stepmother and stepson following public tensions, including a video in which Michelle said she had been humiliated by Flávio.

item.title: Conselho de Ética aprova continuidade de processo contra Erika Hilton, mas calendário da Câmara pode impedir conclusão
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies' Ethics Committee approved, by a vote of 10 to 5, the continuation of an investigation against Deputy Erika Hilton (Psol-SP), based on a cassation request from the Missão party regarding her social media posts in response to attacks following her election as president of the Women's Commission. However, the process is unlikely to be concluded due to the electoral calendar: deputies will have only one more week of sessions before October, as the first round of elections is on October 4 and the second on October 25, after which the chamber recesses. Although the maximum processing time is 90 days, the rapporteur Gilberto Silva (PL-PB) must still define investigative procedures, and serious sanctions require plenary approval — making completion improbable before the mandate ends in December.

item.title: A nova pesquisa CNT/MDA sobre a disputa presidencial entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The August 2026 CNT/MDA poll shows Lula leading Flávio Bolsonaro in the presidential race, but with a narrowed gap: 48% to 39,1% in a runoff scenario (down from a 12-point lead in June). In the first round, Lula has 42,4% and Flávio 28,7%, while other candidates trail below 5%. The margin of error is ±2,2 percentage points.

item.title: O ‘banho de lama’ eleitoral que deve vir à tona após caso Marcola atingir entorno de Lula
item.description: The departure of Marcola from Lula’s inner circle and the appointment of Oswaldo Malatesta Neto as the new chief of staff aim to reduce political damage to the government following the scandal involving the former aide. According to Robson Bonin, Malatesta Neto’s mission is to remain discreet, avoid creating problems, and focus on administrative duties as the government seeks to move past the episode ahead of the 2026 elections. The analyst argues that political events, even non-electoral ones, are quickly converted into electoral ammunition, especially on social media, where polarization amplifies negative narratives against opponents.
